operation: Build a runnable mechanism slice with a manifest, license note, runtime audit and reopened screenshots.
steps: Agree the mechanism set, deviations and stopping point before writing code.
Write manifest, README and license note before completing the implementation.
Expose seed, channels, pass order and collision through real runtime objects.
Run the slice, save the audit and console, reopen screenshots and test one full user path.
acceptance_checks: Every mechanism ref resolves to a dump entity.
Behavior assertions could fail for the defect they claim to catch.
The report does not present the slice as visually equivalent or as full gameplay.

on_failure.retry: Fix the named mechanism or audit defect and re-run the same checks.
on_failure.stop: Stop when the license forbids the deliverable or the runtime cannot be reproduced.
